name: baekgwi-android
description: 백귀야행 — 안드로이드판 껍데기. 알맹이는 game/index.html 하나다.

scripts.prepare:www: node ../../game/build-apps.mjs && rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp ../../dist/android/index.html www/index.html
scripts.add: npm run prepare:www && npx cap add android
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
